implementation.source: slice(array,start,end), including pipelines and direct spawn; preserves exact element and nominal record type
implementation.types: Six existing numeric types, Bool, String and finite records; independently typed signed/unsigned 32-bit/64-bit integer bounds
implementation.ranges: Half-open 0 <= start <= end <= length; statically invalid ranges rejected; dynamic ranges checked before result allocation/read; input and bounds evaluated once in source order
implementation.storage: Ordered outer-cell copy into existing managed storage; numeric logical strides respected; immutable String/record child descriptors shared through existing invocation/task ownership
implementation.planning: Explicit ArraySlice typed operation with input/start/end dataflow, continuation import/remapping, CPU capability validation and shared MLIR loop lowering
implementation.limits: CPU only; no negative/clamped/stepped ranges, GPU arrays or nested arrays. Shared backing views remain a later optimization. No new numeric engine or runtime ABI.

coverage: Frontend nine element types/four integer bound types, empty/literal context, constant errors, pipeline/direct worker calls and malformed typed IR

All six numeric representations: exact arbitrary bits including NaN payloads/signed zero, offset/positive/negative-stride input, empty/full/interior/reversed/high/negative ranges and retained output after invocation settlement
Checked malformed size metadata, pre-entry cancellation and allocation failure without partial output; worker harness covers cancellation/deadlines/admission and scheduler/source allocator failures
Nested worker calls/cached awaits, String/record collection fields, immutable original input, callbacks, fault recovery/rethrow and source location
Bare package/re-export composition through versioned project manifest and compiler/checker; both documented examples compiled/executed in all variants
Freshly rebuilt syntax/semantics, placement/continuation, collection/String/project frontend regressions, existing String slice/array execution and unified Apple GPU CLI
